notes.title: v1.0.2: screen shaketh, screen shaken't
notes.notes: I added an option to disable explosion screen shake under Video. The more dramatic death screen twist effect is still present either way so losing a life will be as harrowing as ever!

notes.title: ACID WEB HAS BEEN UNLEASHED
notes.notes:
After way too long, it's finally here!

Get it now and become the tormentor of turrets, the exterminator of eyes, the nibbler of nachos and the [b]pharaoh of the web![/b] The [b]100 waves[/b] can't wait to make you suffer! [i]Don't[/i] get it now and a dull life bereft of eight-legged skulls awaits you.
